# fjordrun_function_limits (Data Source)

Function runtimes, memory sizes, defaults and limits, overall and per plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_function_limits" "all" {}

output "pro_max_memory_mb" {
  value = data.fjordrun_function_limits.all.plans["pro"].max_memory_mb
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `defaults` (Attributes) Defaults of a new function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--defaults))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `idle_timeout_s` (Attributes) Range of the idle window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--idle_timeout_s))
- `max_code_bytes` (Number) Most inline code.
- `max_files` (Number) Most inline files.
- `max_timeout_s` (Number) Largest timeout of any plan.
- `memory_sizes_mb` (List of Number) Available memory sizes.
- `plans` (Attributes Map) Limits by plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `runtimes` (Attributes List) Available runtimes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtimes))
